messages:
sana: Heads-up: preview invoices show a tiny but consistent bump (~1.9%) after yesterday's routing-window tweak. looks like some streaming requests are being counted twice when rejoin merges happen. anyone else seeing this in shadow? :wave:
obrien: saw a blip in shadow at ~03:05 UTC. quick glance: aggregator emits hedged event during preproc, then a merged join emits another. ledger dedupe keys by join_id only so pre-join emissions slip through.
pat: short-term: add dedupe at aggregator output keyed on (session_id, fingerprint) to stop double-counts for preview pipeline. long-term: canonicalize join_id assignment earlier in the flow.
li: I can run tenant slice. SQL I used:```sql
SELECT tenant_id, route, count(*) dupes
FROM preview_events
WHERE hedged = true AND received_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route
ORDER BY dupes DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: aggregator-dedupe-quickfix -> 5% canary, initiated by pat.
pat: starting canary, adding metric preview.hedged_double_count and a console card for hedged_double_count / hedged_total by route. will watch 1m/5m.
ops-bot: /alert preview-hedge-dup spike=1.9pct env=shadow scope=preview
sana: if canary looks good, promote and add regression test for pre-join+join collapse. also ping CS for tenants with >5 dupes.
pat: canary shows metric -> 0 in slice after 2m. promoting to 100% now. will monitor next invoice-preview run. :thumbsup:
